scope.rule: Modify only files explicitly listed in docs/current_task.xml files_in_scope.
No cross-layer edits without a new task boundary written in docs/current_task.xml.
No simultaneous overlapping file scope across two agents.

invention.rule: No invented API endpoints, env vars, DB columns, type shapes, or file paths.
No mock, stub, or placeholder code unless labeled: // MOCK — remove before merge
If a required fact is absent from docs/context.xml — stop and ask. Do not infer.

dependencies.rule: No new packages without Orchestrator approval.
Before adding any package: verify maintained (last commit under 6 months), no known CVEs, not a duplicate of an existing dep.
Pin exact versions on security-sensitive packages. No floating ^ or ~.

code_quality.rule: No `any` type without inline justification comment on the same line.
No `TODO` or `FIXME` in delivered code — open a new task instead.
No commented-out code blocks in the final diff.
No empty catch blocks — every error path returns a typed response.
No hardcoded secrets, tokens, or credentials anywhere.
No unauthenticated routes without explicit Orchestrator sign-off in docs/current_task.xml.
No deleted or skipped tests to make a build pass.

security.rule: Validate all user input server-side before DB writes.
Parameterized queries only — no SQL string interpolation.
No sensitive data in frontend state or localStorage without encryption.

close_every_turn.report: command + actual output, not a summary
